verdict.rationale: The Intel Core Ultra 9 285K is a desktop CPU, a hardware component that does not collect user data or run a service with training-data policies, so a training-data opt-out is a category error for this product type. Mentions of local on-device AI inference are a related hardware trait, not a data-use control, and do not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
